title: Should the testbed host need to upgrade to Ubuntu 18.04 amd64 server?
author: gord1306
body:
**Description**
The current recommended host OS seems to need to be upgraded to 18.04, otherwise, issue #1481 will happen. 

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
Failed to start VM due to hypervisor not support Ethernet type, same wth the issue #1481 

**Describe the results you received:**
Correct the latest document 

**Describe the results you expected:**
Whether the testbed setup document needs to update to suitable host OS??
